title: NCT exact measured-anchor calibration against the frozen ESOL predictor
scientific_question: For the coverage-selected NCT crystallographic seed, how does the already frozen ESOL predictor behave relative to the exact AqSolDB source observation, and is the seed inside the predictor's inherited applicability domain?

next_program_boundary.rule: MOLDISC-004 only calibrates the selected seed. Any analog generation is a separately frozen program, and every generated analog must be evaluated on its own applicability-domain status.

interpretation_boundaries: The AqSolDB value is an exact-structure source observation but still inherits heterogeneous measurement-protocol limitations.
A single seed comparison is not a new validation benchmark and cannot establish general model accuracy.
An in-domain seed does not imply that generated analogs will remain in domain.
An out-of-domain result does not authorize changing the frozen ESOL threshold or retraining the model inside this program.
No result in MOLDISC-004 establishes binding affinity, potency, efficacy, safety or clinical value.
